title: Student Management System
tagline: A console-based application for managing student records using file storage.
description: A C-based Student Management System that demonstrates structures, arrays, file handling, and modular programming. Users can add, view, search, update, and delete student records while persisting data through file storage.

title: Mini Servo Radar
tagline: A modular Arduino-based radar system with automatic and manual scanning modes, visualized in real time using Processing.
description: An embedded radar system built around the Arduino Uno that combines an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor and an SG90 servo motor to scan a 180° field of view. The project features automatic and potentiometer-controlled manual scanning modes, switchable via a hardware toggle switch, with live radar visualization rendered on a desktop application built with Processing.

title: ESP32 OLED DrawingPad
tagline: A browser-based drawing application that turns any device into a wireless graphics tablet for an ESP32 OLED.
description: Built a real-time drawing system using an ESP32-S3, WebSockets, HTML5 Canvas, and an SSD1306 OLED. Features include live drawing, brush and eraser tools, image upload with Floyd–Steinberg dithering, and direct framebuffer streaming over Wi-Fi.

title: TuneScope
tagline: A standalone ESP32-S3 music recognition device with a real-time OLED audio visualizer.
description: An embedded music recognition device built around the ESP32-S3 that records nearby audio through an INMP441 microphone, identifies songs using the AudD Music Recognition API over Wi-Fi, and presents the results on a 128×64 OLED display with a responsive real-time audio visualizer.
